response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically versatile senior/staff engineer with genuine developer-tools and testing-infrastructure experience (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD setup, GitLab administration) that aligns well with the engineering productivity focus of this role. However, his entire career history shows individual-contributor and staff engineer titles with no evidence of formal people management, direct reports, or team leadership responsibilities, which is a core, non-negotiable requirement for this management-track position.
strengths: Deep, hands-on experience building developer tools and testing frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI pipelines)
Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure, showing strong system design capability
History of teaching/mentoring via workshops and talks, suggesting some leadership and communication aptitude
concerns: No documented experience managing people or leading a team with direct reports
Career trajectory is consistently IC-focused (Staff/Senior Developer), not technical leadership or management roles
No mention of roadmap ownership, organizational change, or cross-team strategic alignment at a management level

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools & testing infrastructure background
No formal technical leadership or team-lead title history
